summary: One thing's detail as a side panel's tab holds it, such as the run, the file or the event chosen in the page beside it: titled sections one under the other, each with an optional sentence, its facts as terms beside their values, and whatever else it shows after them (a preview, the steps of a run, a change), then the thing's verbs on a line at the end. Every section takes the panel's width with a rule under it, the last excepted, and each section's terms line up in one column.

anatomy.section: One section (PanelSection): padded 16 across and 12 down and up, its pieces 8 apart, a 1px rule in border under it, none under the last.
anatomy.heading: The section's title, an h3 in the small group heading's look every group shares: uppercase, a little tracked, in faint.
anatomy.headingRow: With the section's actions: the heading and the actions on one row at least 28 tall, the actions at its end, 4 apart.
anatomy.summary: A sentence over the facts, such as who did what, wrapping evenly.
anatomy.facts: The facts (a DescriptionList beside its terms): each term in a column as wide as termWidth, its value after it, 12 between, the pairs 8 apart. A value not given is a dash in faint.
anatomy.value: A fact's value; in the code face where the fact says code, in tabular figures where it says numeric.
anatomy.content: What follows the facts, given by the app: a preview, the steps of a run, a change.
anatomy.actions: The thing's verbs on a line after the sections, padded 16 across and 12 down and up, 8 apart, wrapping.

sections.does: The sections, in order: { id, title, summary?, facts?, content?, actions? }; facts as { term, value, code?, numeric?, wide? }.

actions.does: The verbs for the thing on a line after the sections, such as Download and Rename.

termWidth.does: How wide each section's term column is: a CSS length, or auto for its longest term, at most 40 percent of the section.

heading.note: text.xs at weight 500, as its paint says; uppercase, tracked wide.

headingRow.note: At least this tall, only with the section's actions.

facts.note: gap: between a term and its value; the pairs stand layout.factsRowGap apart. Lines 20 tall.

factsRowGap.note: Between one fact's line and the next (DescriptionList's row gap).

termMax.note: With termWidth auto, the term column is as wide as the longest term, at most this share of the section.

rest.means: The sections drawn one under the other, then the verbs.

rest.note: 1 wide under each section but the last.
In the ink of what it stands on.
In the ink of what it stands on; a missing value is a dash in faint.

appText.sections: Each section's title, summary, facts (terms and values) and content.

sokkel-ui: Each section is SidePanel's PanelSection and its facts a DescriptionList in the side layout, whose pairs are subgrids so every term shares the column.

drift.today: As of 9038006 there is no detail pane.
